title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Unlacquered Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a covered toilet paper holder that combines a roll holder with a convenient glass shelf in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. Part of the Waverly Place collection, this wall mount accessory is designed to help keep toilet tissue protected while adding a handy spot for small items.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Crafted from solid brass (brass construction)
- Wall mount installation saves space; concealed screw mounting for a clean look
- Includes installation hardware

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place collection
- Category: Toilet Paper Holders
- Style: Traditional (transitional-friendly coordinating design language)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 8.75 in length x 6 in width x 4.6 in height; 6 in projection
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screws: #8 x 1 1/4
- Included items: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
